tei:div.tei:p: gsol 'debs byin rlabs char 'bebs bzhugs/ oṃ/ skyobs pa sangs rgyas 'od dpag med gus pa'i yid kyi gsol ba 'debs/ thugs kyi dgongs pas byin gyis rlobs/ thugs rjes 'jug pas ma btang cig thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs/ gus pa'i yid kyi gsol ba 'debs/ thugs kyi dgongs pas byin gyis rlobs/ thugs rjes 'jug pas ma btang cig rnam sprul lha mo nyi shu gcig gus pa'i yid kyi gsol ba 'debs/ thugs kyi dgongs pas byin gyis rlobs/ (664)thugs rjes 'jug pas ma btang cig ser sngo bsod nams mchod ster ma/ gus pa'i yid kyi gsol ba 'debs/ thugs kyi dgongs pas byin gyis rlobs/ thugs rjes 'jug pas ma btang cig lha cig 'phags ma go 'jo la/ gus pa'i yid kyi gsol ba 'debs/ thugs kyi dgongs pas byin gyis rlobs/ thugs rjes 'jug pas ma btang cig rig 'jin ngag gi dbang po la/ gus pa'i yid kyi gsol ba 'debs/ thugs kyi dgongs pas byin gyis rlobs/ thugs (665)rjes 'jug pas ma btang cig bla ma yi dam 'phags pa'i tshogs/ so sor snang yang ngo bo gcig phyogs ris ma chad sprul par shar/ bla ma 'phags pa dbyer med la/ gus pa'i yid kyi gsol ba 'debs/ thugs kyi dgongs pas byin gyis rlobs/ thugs rjes 'jug pas ma btang cig bdag gi skye dang tshe rabs su/ 'phags ma khyed dang mi 'bral zhing*/ thugs kyi dgongs pas byin rlabs shing*/ byang chub sems la dbang 'byor zhing*/ rgyal sras spyod pa phar (666)phyin drug nyin mtshan med nyam blang na/ bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs nas/ zhing rnams rgya mtshor rab sbyangs zhing*/ sems can rgya mtsho smin byas te/ 'phags ma nyid dang dbyer med par/ dgongs spyod rgya mtshor mnyam par shog ces pa'ang tshe rab rjes 'jin dang 'brel ba'i gsol 'debs padma las 'brel rtsal gyis so/// /
